hero_title: Support While You’re in Halifax Harbour
hero_subtitle: Wherever you are from, you are welcome here. Mission to Seafarers Halifax is here to support you with practical help, connection, hospitality, and care while your ship is visiting the Port of Halifax.
services_title: How Can We Help You Today?
services_subtitle: Select a service below to request assistance quickly.

support_services.title: Request a Ship Visit
support_services.description: Our volunteers and chaplaincy team can visit your ship while you are in port.

support_services.title: Send or Receive Parcel
support_services.description: Order personal items online and have them delivered safely to our Halifax Mission for pickup. Please ensure that all courier and parcel deliveries to the Mission are scheduled within official office hours.

support_services.title: Message the Chaplain
support_services.description: Need someone to talk to? We are here to listen and support you confidentially.

support_services.title: Request Support
support_services.description: We can assist with practical, emotional, transportation, or local support needs while your vessel is visiting the Port of Halifax.

support_services.title: Clothing & Essentials
support_services.description: Access seasonal clothing, gloves, jackets, hygiene items, and practical essentials during your time in port.

support_services.title: Transport & Guidance
support_services.description: Need help getting around Halifax or finding local services? Our team may be able to assist.

commitment_title: Every day, seafarers from around the world arrive in Halifax.
commitment_description: Every day, seafarers from around the world arrive in Halifax after long journeys at sea. Whether you are here for a few hours or several days, our team is here to welcome and support you.

how_it_works_steps.step_desc: Select the service or support you need from our dashboard above.
Fill out a short request form or message our team.
Our volunteers or station team will contact you shortly.

team_title: A Friendly Face While Far From Home
team_subtitle: Our volunteers, chaplaincy team, and station staff are here to welcome you, listen, and support you during your time in Halifax.
welcoming_box_title: We Welcome Seafarers from Around the World
welcoming_box_text: Mission to Seafarers Halifax supports seafarers of all nationalities, cultures, and faiths. If English is not your first language, we will do our best to support you and help you feel comfortable during your visit.
urgent_subtitle: Contact us directly by phone or WhatsApp for immediate support.
civic_address_text:
844 Marginal Road, Halifax NS B3H 2P7, Nova Scotia
Situated across from Pier 24 in the Halifax Seaport area.
hours_note: Note: Ship visits and seafarer support may still occur outside regular station hours depending on vessel schedules.
